notes.title: You will never believe how the mom walks!
notes.notes:
After the construction of the home world, now it is the turn of the mom to walk on the floor.
To walk on floors you should first click on the mom and then choose the walk option, now it's time to choose a new position to move on.
Let's see a simple one:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833411/f3a6a8621f0e3e87b0dde0e0e15e58e75d40dc04.png[/img]

The mom is smarter than you think. If various objects are blocking the space on the way, she can move through the objects, find the closest path to the destination, and then move without hitting the objects.
Let's see another one:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833411/2cc8c1e16471d7785a4a958b55cab8b4e11855b0.png[/img]
